title: Enabling UE_MCP_Bridge in committed .uproject auto-starts an unauthenticated WebSocket exposing execute_python (local RCE) on every editor boot
detail: Committed enable makes StartupModule auto-start an unauthenticated WebSocket every editor boot. Any local process (sandboxed/multi-user machine) can call execute_python — arbitrary code execution as the editor user. Loopback-only binding and Editor-only module mitigate but do not authenticate.
recommended_fix: Gate the bridge behind explicit opt-in (command-line switch or ue-mcp.yml enable) instead of always-on when the plugin loads, or require a token handshake on the WebSocket upgrade. Document the residual local-trust assumption.

title: BlueprintCallable BeginDraw/EndDraw feed unchecked float→int32 narrowing casts in ScreenToGrid (UB on non-finite/out-of-range input)
detail: The documented bridge-drivable entry point accepts arbitrary FVector2D with no finite/range check; NaN or out-of-range doubles make the narrowing cast UB, and a zero-viewport Scale divides by zero. Downstream snap + ApplyEdit validation bounds impact to a rejected edit.
recommended_fix: In ScreenToGrid, guard Scale > 0 and clamp ScreenPos to the viewport rect; return an off-map sentinel grid position for non-finite input before the narrowing cast.
